title: The microcrack inhibition and mechanical properties of an in-situ synthesized refractory high-entropy alloy fabricated by additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by in-situ alloying from blended elemental powders via laser directed energy deposition (DED) technique with laser power of 400–650 W, laser scanning speed of 4 mm/s, layer thickness of 76 μm and a hatching distance of 305 μm under a protective atmosphere of argon
